## Witherstench (CR 1)

**XP** 400  
 N Small magical beast  

**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +5; **Aura** stench (DC 12, while within 30 ft. plus 1 round)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 14, touch 13, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +1 natural, +1 size)  

**hp** 22 (2d10+2)  

**Fort** +4, **Ref** +5, **Will** +0  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft.  

**Melee** 2 claws +5 (1d4+2)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 8, **Dex** 14, **Con** 12, **Int** 2, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 4  

**Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +3; **CMD** 12 (16 vs. trip)  

**Feats** Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  

**Skills** Perception +5  

**Special Abilities**

 **Stench (Ex)** A witherstench constantly emits a putrid stench that nearly every form of animal life finds offensive. All living creatures (except witherstenches) within 30 feet of a witherstench must succeed on a DC 12 Fortitude save or be nauseated 1 for as long as they remain within 30 feet of the creature. Moving out of the affected area leaves the character sickened for 1 round after which time he recovers immediately. The save DC is Constitution-based.
